event.name: AzuriteCon
event.description: AzuriteCon is a celebration of anime, gaming, comics and creativity. Join fellow fans for a weekend of independent makers, alternative Japanese fashion, panels, performances, cosplay and community in the heart of Newtown.

faq.question: Where is AzuriteCon?
faq.answer: AzuriteCon will be held at 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042.

faq.question: When does online ticket sales end?
faq.answer: Online Eventbrite sales end Thursday, 15 April 2027.

faq.question: Can I buy tickets on the day?
faq.answer: Market Entry is $11 on the day. The $15 Saturday Market + Panels & Performances ticket is online sales only. Kids aged 12 years or under are $4 on the day.

faq.question: How do I apply for Artist Alley?
faq.answer: Use the Artist Alley application link on this website. Application dates, table packages and requirements can be added here when confirmed.

faq.question: How do I get to the venue?
faq.answer: The venue is at 1 Bedford St in Newtown. Add your final transport and parking information before publishing.

faq.question: Where can I find bump-in details?
faq.answer: Artist bump-in times, loading instructions, parking and pack-down information will be published here for accepted artists.
